children: RNS Number : 8385X  Competition and Markets Authority  07 October 2026
Publication of full text: Co-operative Group/Southern Co-operative

The CMA has published the text of its decision on the acquisition by Co-operative Group Limited of The Southern Co-operative Limited which was announced on 15 September 2026. This decision can be found on the Competition and Markets Authority's website at https://www.gov.uk/cma-cases.
In the event of media enquiries please email press@cma.gov.uk.
